questions.question: Is your manufacturing site(s) certified to ISO 9001:2015? Provide certificate number and validity.
questions.full: Valid ISO 9001:2015 certificate covering supplying plant(s)
questions.partial: Not applicable – applied / in process scores 0 and fails mandatory

questions.question: Do you hold FSC Chain-of-Custody certification?
questions.partial: Application in process with audit date

questions.question: Can you supply board meeting SCPL minimum recycled-content levels (70% domestic grades / 50% export & litho grades) with a supplier declaration per lot?
questions.full: Meets minimums on all grades with declaration

questions.question: State installed annual corrugation capacity (MT) and current utilisation. Minimum 6,000 MTPA installed required.
Describe in-house testing: do you test GSM, bursting strength, ECT/BCT, moisture and Cobb per lot and issue a COA with every delivery?
questions.full: In-house lab covering GSM, BS, ECT/BCT, moisture, Cobb + COA per lot
questions.partial: Partial test coverage or no COA (fails mandatory)

questions.question: Is every carton/bundle marked with a batch/lot code traceable to paper reels and production date?
questions.full: Lot code on every carton, traceable to reels

questions.question: Standard lead time from PO (repeat items) – SCPL target <= 14 days.
Complaint SLA: acknowledgement within 24 h and CAPA within 7 days?
questions.partial: Slower than one of the targets

questions.question: List production plants and distance to each SCPL plant. Plants within 350 km preferred.
questions.full: Plants within 350 km of all 3 SCPL plants (8)

questions.question: Do you have a documented business-continuity plan (alternate plant or contracted converter, >= 15 days raw-material buffer, multiple paper mills)?
questions.full: Documented BCP meeting all three elements

questions.question: Can you supply water-resistant coated board achieving Cobb(30 min) <= 40 g/m2?
Printing capability: flexo up to 4 colours and offset litho-lamination in-house?
questions.partial: One of the two in-house (other via partner or not available)

questions.question: Sustainability practices: ISO 14001, effluent/waste management, recycled fibre sourcing, carbon reporting.
Hygiene controls for food-contact-adjacent packaging (BRCGS Packaging / ISO 22000 / FSSC, pest control, GMP).

qualification.rule: Vendor qualifies only if total score >= 70/100 AND every mandatory question (Q01, Q04, Q05, Q06, Q10) is answered with full compliance. Unanswered questions score 0; an unanswered mandatory question fails qualification.
